title: Sweep: Aave Grants DAO (aave)
summary: Aave Grants DAO is Aave's grant-making arm, organizing grant recipients into three-month funding rounds through its own application portal (aavegrants.org) rather than a page on aave.com itself.

title: Sweep: Acquia Fair Trade Initiative (acquia-fair-trade-initiative)
summary: Acquia commits 2% of every closed eligible partner deal to the Drupal Association, credited in the partner's name, as an automatic structural funding commitment with no separate grant application process.

title: Sweep: Aethir Ecosystem Fund (aethir-ecosystem-fund)
summary: Aethir's $100 million Ecosystem Fund backs AI and gaming projects building on Aethir's decentralized cloud infrastructure, with applications submitted through an online form.

title: Sweep: Amazon Research Awards (amazon-research-awards-amazon-science)
summary: Amazon Research Awards give university researchers up to $100,000 in unrestricted funds plus up to $50,000 in AWS Promotional Credits, awarded across periodic calls for proposals.

title: Sweep: Apple Scholars in AI/ML (apple-scholars-in-ai-ml)
summary: Apple Scholars in AI/ML is a PhD fellowship providing roughly two years of stipend, tuition coverage, a travel grant, and mentorship to doctoral students in AI/ML fields nominated by partner universities.

title: Sweep: Shared Horizons Fund (astralis-foundation)
summary: Astralis Foundation operates the Shared Horizons Fund, a multi-funder vehicle for AI safety grantmaking led by Senior Advisor Tim Shavers; sourced from a specialist longtermist tracking wiki rather than Astralis's own site, so should be verified before promotion.

org_name: BARDA (Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority)
title: Sweep: BARDA DRIVe (EZ-BAA) (barda-biomedical-advanced-research-and-development-authority)
summary: BARDA's DRIVe division runs EZ-BAA, a rolling funding mechanism partnering with early-stage companies on health-security innovations; DRIVe's partnering approaches vary by project.

org_name: BARDA (Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority)
title: Sweep: BARDA Accelerator Network (barda-biomedical-advanced-research-and-development-authority)
summary: The BARDA Accelerator Network offers proof-of-concept funding opportunities year-round with rolling application submissions and priority deadlines, part of BARDA's DRIVe partnering approach for health-security innovation.

title: Sweep: Base Builder Grants (base-coinbase)
summary: Base runs its own retroactive Builder Grants (1-5 ETH per shipped project, 20+ cohorts since 2024) for developers shipping live on the Base mainnet; note this is distinct from Coinbase Developer Platform's separately-registered CDP Builder Grants program, so check for overlap before promoting.

title: Sweep: CEPI Calls for Proposals (cepi-coalition-for-epidemic-preparedness-innovations)
summary: CEPI's Calls for Proposals invite vaccine and biosecurity innovators worldwide to apply to its scientific programs, funding R&D across a diverse portfolio of vaccine candidates against epidemic threats.

title: Sweep: Global Impact Cash Grant Program (cisco-foundation)
summary: Cisco's Global Impact Cash Grant Program funds community partners worldwide via an online grants management portal, with Cisco also connecting recipients to pro-bono strategic and technical advisory services.

title: Sweep: Foundational Fund (co-impact)
summary: Co-Impact's Foundational Fund supports efforts to deliver lasting change to health, education, and economic systems across Africa, Asia, and Latin America, and to advance gender equality.

title: Sweep: Global Catastrophic Risks Opportunities Fund (coefficient-giving)
summary: Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy) runs a Global Catastrophic Risks Opportunities Fund as one of several open-application funds, alongside Global Health and Wellbeing, Farm Animal Welfare, and Effective Giving & Careers funds.

title: Sweep: Deep Funding (AI-PGF) (deep-funding)
summary: Deep Funding is listed on Gitcoin as an AI public-goods-funding mechanism; the org's own profile independently confirms it runs milestone-based grants, RFPs, and hackathons for decentralized-AI builders, consistent with this citation.

title: Sweep: Digital Freedom Fund Grants (digital-freedom-fund)
summary: The Digital Freedom Fund funds three types of activity — litigation, pre-litigation, and post-litigation — advancing digital rights through strategic litigation in Europe, with open calls reviewed by community peers.

title: Sweep: FLOSS/fund (floss-fund)
summary: FLOSS/fund provides roughly $1M per year to free and open source projects; applicants create a funding.json manifest in their repo and apply through its public directory.

title: Sweep: FOSS United Grants (foss-united)
summary: FOSS United Foundation runs a grants program (a 25-lakh INR budget as of 2025) for FOSS projects and developers in India, covering both event grants and project grants via an online application.

title: Sweep: All Grants Fund (givewell)
summary: GiveWell's All Grants Fund lets donors support the full range of GiveWell's grantmaking in global health and well-being, including incubating newer programs alongside its top charities.

title: Sweep: Global Innovation Fund (global-innovation-fund-gif)
summary: The Global Innovation Fund is a non-profit, impact-first investment fund that funds social innovations improving the lives of underserved and vulnerable people, with an open application for funding.

title: Sweep: Prosperity Grants Program (gooddollar)
summary: GoodDollar's Prosperity Grants Program funds projects that bridge the economic wealth gap through financial access, inclusivity, and education, and is now officially accepting applications.

title: Sweep: Google Academic Research Awards (google-academic-research-awards)
summary: Google Academic Research Awards fund academic researchers advising students and conducting technology and computing research, through periodic nomination-based calls for proposals.

title: Sweep: The Graph Grants Program (graph-foundation)
summary: The Graph Foundation runs Grants & RFPs for developers and teams contributing to protocol, tooling, subgraph, and dApp development across the Web3 ecosystem, alongside open requests for proposals from core contributors.

title: Sweep: ICF Funding Program (interchain-foundation)
summary: The Interchain Foundation's Funding Program supports development of open-source decentralized networks across the Cosmos ecosystem, run alongside a separately restarted Grants Program for a wider range of organizations.

title: Sweep: LEGO (Lido Ecosystem Grants Organization) (lido)
summary: LEGO (Lido Ecosystem Grants Organization) funds individuals, projects, and initiatives that benefit the Lido protocol and the broader blockchain space.

title: Sweep: Linea Ecosystem Investment Alliance (EIA) (linea-consensys)
summary: ConsenSys launched the Linea Ecosystem Investment Alliance with 30+ venture capital firms to support builders on Linea, announced alongside Linea's mainnet launch and separate developer grants.

title: Sweep: Open Source Endowment (open-source-endowment)
summary: The Open Source Endowment is billed as the first endowment fund dedicated to sustainably funding open source projects, investing donations in a low-risk portfolio and disbursing only investment income as grants, starting with roughly $5,000 microgrants.

title: Sweep: Silicon Catalyst Incubator (silicon-catalyst)
summary: Silicon Catalyst bills itself as the semiconductor industry's first incubator, providing in-kind partner resources, mentorship, and investor access; its portfolio companies have received over $100M in grants.

title: Sweep: Stripe Climate (stripe-climate)
summary: Stripe Climate lets businesses of any size fund frontier carbon removal by directing a share of revenue to Stripe's portfolio of carbon-removal purchases.

title: Sweep: AI-BOOST AI Challenge Competition (ai-boost)
summary: AI-BOOST's AI Challenge Competition is an open competition with a €100,000 prize pool across four generative AI challenges, part of a European AI ecosystem-building project.

title: Sweep: Algorand Foundation Grants Program (algorand-foundation)
summary: The Algorand Foundation's Grants Program is a broad, multi-year, worldwide program funding projects that grow the Algorand ecosystem, launched with a 250-million ALGO commitment.

title: Sweep: Algorand xGov (algorand-xgov)
summary: Algorand xGov is a decentralized, on-chain platform where xGov council members analyze community grant proposals and vote to select which ones receive funding.

title: Sweep: ARDC Grants (amateur-radio-digital-communications)
summary: ARDC (Amateur Radio Digital Communications) funds projects that advance amateur radio, digital communications, and related technologies through an open grants application process, with awards announced annually.

title: Sweep: Dolphin Awards and Fellowships (apereo-foundation)
summary: Apereo Foundation's Dolphin Awards and Fellowships recognize and fund teaching-and-learning work built on open source education software, including a Dolphin Fellows track.

title: Sweep: Arc Ignite Awards (arc-institute)
summary: Arc Institute's Ignite Award gives a one-time $100,000 gift to kickstart ambitious research ideas that are difficult to fund through traditional grant mechanisms.

title: Sweep: ASI:Accelerator Programme (artificial-superintelligence-alliance)
summary: The Artificial Superintelligence Alliance's ASI:Accelerator Programme gives applicants access to AI insights, enterprise-grade infrastructure, and dedicated mentorship, alongside separate grant programs run by member projects SingularityNET and Fetch.ai.

title: Sweep: BNB Chain Grants (bnb-chain)
summary: BNB Chain Grants funds developers building open-source initiatives and projects on or migrating to BNB Chain, part of a wider set of builder support programs.

title: Sweep: Project Catalyst (cardano-foundation)
summary: Project Catalyst is Cardano's community-driven, on-chain innovation funding process; the Cardano Foundation has adjusted its strategy across rounds, most recently limiting voting power and increasing focus on community-led governance in round F14.

title: Sweep: Founder Catalyst Program (cardano-foundation)
summary: Techstars and the Cardano Foundation launched the Founder Catalyst Program, a new accelerator initiative for Web3 founders building on Cardano.

title: Sweep: ChainGPT Web3-AI Grant (chaingpt)
summary: ChainGPT offers up to $1 million in tiered Web3-AI Grants, including research grants up to $5K in API credit, to accelerate AI-powered blockchain projects.

title: Sweep: Chainlink Community Grant Program (chainlink)
summary: The Chainlink Community Grant Program funds development teams and researchers building a more functional, accessible, and socially impactful smart contract economy.

title: Sweep: Compound Grants Program (compound-dao)
summary: The Compound Grants Program (CGP) was a community-run grants program funding Compound ecosystem contributions, administered independently via Questbook, with the community publishing a lessons-and-next-steps retrospective on the forum.

title: Sweep: CCC Research Fund (confidential-computing-consortium)
summary: The Confidential Computing Consortium's Research Fund awards grants for practical academic research in confidential computing, with applications submitted directly to the consortium's research team.

title: Sweep: COTI Builders Program (coti)
summary: The COTI Builders Program is COTI Foundation's grants program funding developers building COTI-based solutions, run through a public GitHub repo of RFPs, alongside a separate $500K Gitcoin-partnered grants round for privacy projects.

title: Sweep: DARPA DICE (darpa-dice)
summary: DARPA's DICE (Decentralized Artificial Intelligence through Controlled Emergence) program, run by the Information Processing Technologies Office, solicits research and technology proposals; third-party trackers note the current solicitation is closed.

title: Sweep: Decentraland DAO Grants (decentraland)
summary: Decentraland's DAO Grants let users submit and vote on funding proposals across defined grant categories, tracked publicly, with enacted proposals including the Decentraland Ambassador's Program.

title: Sweep: Defactor Accelerator Grant Fund (defactor)
summary: Defactor's Accelerator Grant Fund offers roughly $250,000-260,000 to real-world-asset (RWA) projects tokenizing onchain, launched jointly with RWA.io as a global acceleration initiative.

title: Sweep: DFINITY Developer Grants Program (dfinity-internet-computer)
summary: The DFINITY Foundation's Developer Grants Program funds developers building on the Internet Computer, including a dedicated DeAI grant track for AI applications on ICP.

title: Sweep: Drupal Association Community Grants & Scholarships (drupal-association)
summary: The Drupal Association offers scholarships and community grants tied to DrupalCon events, part of the programs it runs to keep Drupal's infrastructure and community functioning; evidence is a single event-specific page rather than a standing program landing page, so this should be verified before promotion.

program: eBPF Foundation Academic Research Grant Program
title: Sweep: eBPF Foundation Academic Research Grant Program (ebpf-foundation)
summary: The eBPF Foundation's Academic Research Grant Program awarded five $50,000 grants in 2024 for academic research benefiting the eBPF community, inviting university faculty to apply.

programs/ebpf-foundation-academic-resear.name: eBPF Foundation Academic Research Grant Program

title: Sweep: ECMWF Grants (ecmwf)
summary: ECMWF Grants, adopted in 2025, is a funding instrument providing financial support to organizations whose activities contribute to ECMWF's objectives.

title: Sweep: Copernicus Grants (ecmwf)
summary: Copernicus Grants, administered through ECMWF, includes calls such as the C3S National Collaboration Programme, with proposals submitted via ECMWF's Call Package and submission portal.

title: Sweep: Effective Altruism Funds (effective-ventures)
summary: Effective Ventures Foundation hosts Effective Altruism Funds, which fund high-impact projects aiming to positively influence the long-term trajectory of civilization, alongside separate Group Support Grants run by its Centre for Effective Altruism.
